name: send_contractor_email
description: Send the validated procedure e-mail to the equipment contractor/provider. Only allowed once the case status is APPROVED by the conformity expert; the recipient is the contractor e-mail stored on the case, or the optional contractor_email argument when the technician supplies it after case creation. In mock mode (default) the e-mail is logged instead of sent, and the case still moves to CONTRACTOR_NOTIFIED.

case_id.description: The approved case the e-mail refers to.

subject.description: E-mail subject, include the case id.

body.description: E-mail body with the final validated procedure.

contractor_email.description: Optional. Contractor e-mail, when the technician supplies it after case creation (the case has none recorded). It is persisted on the case.

name: request_expert_validation
description: Notify the conformity expert that a case awaits validation of its draft procedure. Call right after create_case.

summary.description: One-line summary of the draft procedure for the expert.
